name: vulsor-ai
description: A private, local-first desktop workspace: browser, AI chat, notes vault, code editor and a set of built-in tools, in one Electron app.

scripts.build:wasm: em++ cpp/starfield.cpp -O3 --no-entry -sSTANDALONE_WASM -sINITIAL_MEMORY=33554432 -o js/wasm/starfield.wasm && em++ cpp/galaxy.cpp -O3 --no-entry -sSTANDALONE_WASM -o js/wasm/galaxy.wasm
scripts.build:css: node build-extras/gen-palette.js && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i build-extras/tailwind-input.css -o css/tailwind.css --minify

author: Alexander Home
